summary_1line: Madri gains twin sons Nakula and Sahadeva through the Ashvins via Kunti’s mantra; the five Pandavas grow up in the forest, and Pandu later roams spring woods with Madri.

image_candidates.scene_text: The twin Ashvin gods appear before Madri and bless her with twin sons as a radiant light fills the forest hermitage.
The five young Pandava brothers stand together on the mountain slope among watching sages, shining with celestial beauty.
In a forest bursting with spring blossoms and humming bees, Pandu walks through flowering trees with Madri at his side.
